task.ques: Locate a C++ project on GitHub that has been recently updated in the last week and has at least 500 stars, then describe its main purpose.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: OpenCV (opencv/opencv) is a C++ project that provides an open source library for computer vision and image processing. On October 28, 2026, GitHub showed 91,354 stars (displayed as 91.4k) and “Updated 3 minutes ago,” meeting both the 500-star minimum and the requirement for an update within the last week (October 21–28, 2026).

Repository: https://github.com/opencv/opencv
Evidence: https://github.com/search?q=opencv+language%3AC%2B%2B+stars%3A%3E%3D500+pushed%3A2026-10-21..2026-10-28&type=repositories&s=updated&o=desc
